risk_summary: The excerpt uses extensive boilerplate forward-looking language and repeated disclaimers that limit predictive accountability. It nevertheless discloses substantial risks, including COVID-19-driven revenue declines, precarious liquidity, reliance on short-term financing and PPP funds, debt default exposure, litigation, customer concentration, and an inability to issue additional equity. Quantitative revenue and working-capital data provide useful specificity, but the overall risk tone is materially negative with only cautious optimism about recovery.
